slider.label: Exposure
slider.name: tone_exposure
slider.tool_tip: Overall image brightness applied by the tonemapper

combo_box.name: tone_type_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Which tonemapping operator maps scene brightness to your display

slider.label: Tonemap mix
slider.name: tone_mix
slider.tool_tip: Blend between linear (0) and tonemapped (1) color. Classic/legacy skies force this to 0.

button.label: Reset All
button.name: sec_tone_reset
button.tool_tip: Reset this section (including Advanced) to defaults

slider.label: ACES white point
slider.name: tone_aces_white
slider.tool_tip: White point for the ACES Boosted operator (no effect on other operators)

slider.label: Reinhard white point
slider.name: tone_reinhard_white
slider.tool_tip: White point for the Reinhard operator (no effect on other operators)

slider.label: Filmic white point
slider.name: tone_filmic_white
slider.tool_tip: White point for the Filmic operator (no effect on other operators)

slider.label: AgX contrast
slider.name: tone_agx_contrast
slider.tool_tip: Contrast for the AgX operator (no effect on other operators)

slider.label: AgX white point
slider.name: tone_agx_white
slider.tool_tip: White point for the AgX operator (no effect on other operators)

check_box.label: Automatic exposure (HDR)
check_box.tool_tip: Dynamically adapt exposure to scene brightness. Requires HDR rendering.
check_box.name: tone_autoexposure

slider.label: Auto-exposure strength
slider.name: tone_autoexp_coeff
slider.tool_tip: How strongly automatic exposure reacts to scene luminance

slider.label: Adapt speed (far)
slider.name: tone_autoexp_speed_error
slider.tool_tip: How quickly exposure adapts while far from its target

slider.label: Adapt speed (near)
slider.name: tone_autoexp_speed_target
slider.tool_tip: How quickly exposure settles once near its target

check_box.label: Use sky exposure range
check_box.tool_tip: Let the active sky's HDR settings define the automatic exposure range
check_box.name: tone_autoexp_sky

button.label: Reset All
button.name: sec_tone_adv_reset
button.tool_tip: Reset the advanced tone settings to defaults

accordion_tab.header_check_box.name: grading_enable
accordion_tab.header_check_box.tool_tip: Master switch for ALL color grading: the 3D LUT plus every Basic, White Balance, Split Toning, Lift / Gamma / Gain and Tone Curve control. This one is a setting and is saved with the Look, unlike the per-section switches.

text.name: grading_compare_note
text.tool_tip: Switching a section off saves nothing and does not mark the Look as changed, and every section comes back when the Lightbox closes.
text.value: Untick a section's header checkbox to switch it off while you look.

text.name: reference_label
text.value: Reference still: freeze a frame and compare against it

button.label: Grab
button.name: reference_grab
button.tool_tip: Freeze the frame as it is now and compare against it while you keep grading. The still is taken where the scopes measure: after every post pass, before the vignette and grain, which are then applied to both sides so the comparison is about the grade. Cleared when the Lightbox closes or the window is resized.

button.label: Clear
button.name: reference_clear
button.tool_tip: Discard the reference still and return to the live image

combo_box.name: reference_mode
combo_box.tool_tip: How the still is shown against the live image

slider.label: Wipe position
slider.name: reference_position
slider.tool_tip: Where the seam sits across the frame: the still to its left, the live image to its right

accordion_tab.header_check_box.name: section_basic
accordion_tab.header_check_box.tool_tip: Whether Basic is applied. Untick to switch the section off while you compare: nothing is saved, the Look is not marked as changed, and it comes back when the Lightbox closes.

slider.label: Temperature (K)
slider.name: basic_temp
slider.tool_tip: Temperature shift in Kelvin from neutral daylight. Negative warms, positive cools. Try -2500 tungsten, -1000 golden hour, 1500 blue hour.

slider.label: Tint
slider.name: basic_tint
slider.tool_tip: Green/magenta tint, perpendicular to temperature. Negative pushes magenta, positive pushes green.

button.label: Pick neutral...
button.name: basic_wb_pick
button.tool_tip: Click something in world that should look white or grey, and both sliders above are solved to make it so. Pick a well lit spot: a surface in deep shadow carries too little colour to read.

slider.label: Contrast
slider.name: basic_contrast
slider.tool_tip: S-curve around mid grey. 1 is identity; below flattens, above punches. Past 1.3 starts clipping.

slider.label: Highlights
slider.name: basic_highlights
slider.tool_tip: Recovers (negative) or boosts (positive) the brightest tones without touching midtones. Use -0.3 to pull a blown sky back.

slider.label: Shadows
slider.name: basic_shadows
slider.tool_tip: Lifts (positive) or crushes (negative) the darkest tones without touching midtones. Use +0.2 to open up a dark scene.

slider.label: White point
slider.name: basic_whites
slider.tool_tip: The input level that becomes pure white. 1 is identity; lowering it blooms highlights and, further down, gives a bleach-bypass look.

slider.label: Black point
slider.name: basic_blacks
slider.tool_tip: The input level that becomes pure black. 0 is identity; 0.05 deepens blacks cinematically, beyond 0.1 starts losing shadow detail.

slider.label: Vibrance
slider.name: basic_vibrance
slider.tool_tip: Saturation that pushes muted colours harder than already-saturated ones. Kinder to skin than Saturation; 0.3 is a subtle lift.

slider.label: Saturation
slider.name: basic_saturation
slider.tool_tip: Uniform saturation. 1 is identity, 0 is black and white, 1.2 is punchy.

slider.label: Brightness
slider.name: basic_brightness
slider.tool_tip: Shifts the whole image lighter or darker in display space, after the tonemap. For overall exposure, use Exposure & Tone instead.

slider.label: Hue shift
slider.name: basic_hue_shift
slider.tool_tip: Rotates every hue around the colour wheel, in degrees. 30 warms everything; 180 is a full complement.

accordion_tab.header_check_box.name: section_primaries
accordion_tab.header_check_box.tool_tip: Whether Lift / Gamma / Gain is applied. Untick to switch the section off while you compare: nothing is saved, the Look is not marked as changed, and it comes back when the Lightbox closes.

color_wheel.label: Lift
color_wheel.name: wheel_lift
color_wheel.tool_tip: Adds to every tone, which shows most in the shadows. Drag the puck to tint, the slider to raise or crush the black floor. Double-click the face to neutralise.

color_wheel.label: Gamma
color_wheel.name: wheel_gamma
color_wheel.tool_tip: Bends the middle of the range without moving black or white. Above 1 opens the midtones, below 1 closes them.

color_wheel.label: Gain
color_wheel.name: wheel_gain
color_wheel.tool_tip: Multiplies every tone, which shows most in the highlights. Drag the puck to tint whites, the slider to boost or tame them.

accordion_tab.header_check_box.name: section_split
accordion_tab.header_check_box.tool_tip: Whether Split Toning is applied. Untick to switch the section off while you compare: nothing is saved, the Look is not marked as changed, and it comes back when the Lightbox closes.

color_wheel.label: Shadows
color_wheel.name: wheel_split_shadow
color_wheel.tool_tip: Colour pushed into the darker tones. Try a cool teal against warm highlights. There is no master here: the renderer normalises tint brightness away.

color_wheel.label: Midtones
color_wheel.name: wheel_split_midtone
color_wheel.tool_tip: Colour pushed into the middle tones. Warm tints flatter skin.

color_wheel.label: Highlights
color_wheel.name: wheel_split_highlight
color_wheel.tool_tip: Colour pushed into the brighter tones. Try warm amber against teal shadows.

curve_editor.name: split_tone_graph
curve_editor.tool_tip: Which tones each tint reaches. Drag the middle handle to slide the split point (the Balance slider); drag the left and right handles to set how far the shadow and highlight tints reach (the Width sliders). Each band is drawn in the colour it applies and fades as its amount drops.

slider.label: Amount
slider.name: split_amount
slider.tool_tip: Strength of the shadow and highlight tints. The midtone tint has its own amount below and works on its own.

slider.label: Midtone amount
slider.name: split_midtone_amount
slider.tool_tip: Strength of the midtone tint, separate from the shadow and highlight amount.

slider.label: Balance
slider.name: split_balance
slider.tool_tip: Slides the split point between shadows and highlights. Negative widens the shadow range, positive widens the highlight range.

slider.label: Shadow width
slider.name: split_shadow_width
slider.tool_tip: How far below the split point the shadow tint reaches full strength. 0.02 is a hard edge, 0.5 a very soft one. The left handle on the graph.

slider.label: Highlight width
slider.name: split_highlight_width
slider.tool_tip: How far above the split point the highlight tint reaches full strength. 0.02 is a hard edge, 0.5 a very soft one. The right handle on the graph.

accordion_tab.header_check_box.name: section_lut
accordion_tab.header_check_box.tool_tip: Whether the 3D LUT is applied. Untick to switch the section off while you compare: nothing is saved, the Look is not marked as changed, and it comes back when the Lightbox closes.

combo_box.name: colorlut_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Which color look-up table to grade with. Files dropped into the user 'colorlut' folder appear here.

slider.label: Strength
slider.name: lut_strength
slider.tool_tip: How strongly the LUT grades the image

button.label: Open Folder
button.name: lut_open_folder
button.tool_tip: Open your LUT folder in the file browser. Drop .cube or image LUTs there; new files are listed the next time the Lightbox opens.

accordion_tab.header_check_box.name: section_curve
accordion_tab.header_check_box.tool_tip: Whether the Tone Curve is applied. Untick to switch the section off while you compare: nothing is saved, the Look is not marked as changed, and it comes back when the Lightbox closes.

combo_box.name: tone_curve_channel
combo_box.tool_tip: Which curve the graph edits. Master applies to all three channels after their own curves; a channel shows its combined result and any other shaped channel behind it.

menu_button.label: Presets
menu_button.name: tone_curve_presets
menu_button.tool_tip: Replace the selected curve with a starting shape

button.name: tone_curve_channel_rst
button.tool_tip: Reset the selected curve to a straight line

curve_editor.name: tone_curve_graph
curve_editor.tool_tip: Drag a point to shape the selected curve. Double-click empty space to add a point (up to 16), double-click a point to remove it; the two end points move only up and down. The straight line is no change. Behind the curve: what the channel gets once Master is applied, and any other channel that is not straight.

slider.label: Amount
slider.name: curve_amount
slider.tool_tip: How much of the curves is applied. 0 leaves the image untouched, 1 applies them fully.
